note: Montrose Lake, a 1,600-acre power-plant cooling lake on Deepwater Creek, leased to MDC; known for catfish, birding and waterfowl. This spot is on the south shore off Southwest 1151: a gravel lane past the boat ramp and privy to a turnaround, with the camping area on the grass beside it, in view of the lake through scattered trees. No hookups or water. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: map/GIS-designated camping on the south-shore lane by the ramp and privy (GIS 54 = pin). Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights now manual. Lakeview kept; phone matches; the second camping area (GIS 55, a two-loop camp 1.4 km NW on its own drive) qualifies for a split.
flags: INCLUSION OK: area page 'Things to Do: Camping: Individual Campsites'; brochure 'Camping is permitted only in designated areas'; the map (9/28/2026) has two 'Camping Area' symbols, each with a privy and boat ramp; GIS 27 points 54 and 55. Rule 140 standard; no special-use-only rule, no Rule 101.

PIN: stored 38.29984,-93.96038 = GIS 54, on mowed grass beside the gravel lane that runs SW from the ramp loop (lot 749, 113 m NE, with the privy) to a turnaround on the shore. Drivable for a 23-ft rig; keep. No ford or posted limit.

SPLIT CANDIDATE: GIS 55 (38.30902,-93.97181), 1.4 km NW on the Deepwater Creek arm near the area office, on its own gravel drive off the east-west road north of the lake (lot 754 is a separate lot 370 m W). Imagery shows a purpose-built camp there: a privy at the drive's head and two gravel loops (~60 m and ~110 m long) under open trees, ~20-40 m from the creek arm through trees. Nothing else in campgrounds.json within 1 km of it (only this entry, 1.4 km). It is more than a single small lot and has its own entrance, so it meets the split rule; it is also arguably the area's main camp. Suggested: a new entry 'Montrose Conservation Area - North Camp' (or similar) pinned ~38.30900,-93.97170 on the loops, waterfront to be judged on its own (creek arm through trees: likely riverview at most). If not split, this entry stays on the south lane.
WATERFRONT: lakeview kept. The lane and turnaround run ~15-60 m from Montrose Lake through scattered (leafless) trees; the open ramp point is the day-use loop, so not upgraded.

SEASON: stored season (year-round, manual, note 'Portions of the area are closed to protect waterfowl, October 15 through March 1.') left unchanged. The map hatches two 'Waterfowl Refuge (Oct 15 through Mar. 1)' zones: the east end of the lake (~3 km E of both camping areas) and a small tract west of the lake's west arm (~0.5 km SW of the north camp). Neither covers a camping area, so the closure does not close the campsites; the season note could be dropped by hand.
FACILITIES: the map draws a privy at both camping areas (not written; the schema's vault_toilets could take it by hand).
NOTE: rewritten; dropped the 14-day limit (booking.max_stay_nights), the acreage, '2 camping spots' (now in the flags), 'Site length not published', the inclusion boilerplate and the directions.
